background: NatWest Markets is the non-ring-fenced bank of NatWest Group, providing rates, currencies and financing to the group's corporate and institutional clients, funded by wholesale markets and the parent.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest at A, all on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. CET1 of 18.3% and LCR of 204% are both in the top quarter of UK majors, with CET1 up 1.2 points and LCR up 11 points since 30 Jun 2025. The weak spots are NSFR of 122%, in the bottom quarter, and leverage, down 0.7 points to 4.9%, just above the peer median. There has been no rating action in the last 90 days.
